note: Hand-drafted from recurring themes in the 10 labelled feedback notes. To be reviewed against scripts/derive_rubric.py and scripts/triage_themes.py output (stage 4). Weights are starting points, tuned by scripts/calibrate.py.
scale: 0 = absent or harmful, 1 = very weak, 2 = weak, 3 = adequate, 4 = good, 5 = excellent. Use null when there is not enough evidence.

dimensions.name: Opening and rapport
dimensions.description: Greets the children and builds rapport before starting content; gives new joiners time to introduce themselves; does not jump straight into revision.
dimensions.evidence_required: Events from the first ~10 minutes: greetings, introductions, warm-up talk, or their absence before the first explanation/revision.
feedback_themes: directly went to revision without rapport

dimensions.name: Individual attention and inclusion
dimensions.description: Calls on children individually by name, involves every child (not just the most active), checks each child's understanding during puzzles and activities.
dimensions.evidence_required: Named questions or check-ins with specific children, spread across the class; how many different children were addressed compared with how many were present.

dimensions.name: Questioning and interaction
dimensions.description: Asks questions that make children think (why/how, which move and why), waits for answers, and responds to what children say with correction or follow-up.
dimensions.evidence_required: Question events with their type, children's responses, and the teacher's follow-up.

dimensions.name: Warmth and energy of communication
dimensions.description: Pleasant, encouraging, enthusiastic communication judged from WHAT is said: praise, encouragement, patience with mistakes, positive framing, humour, interest in the children. Do NOT judge from pitch, loudness, accent, gender or speaking speed.
dimensions.evidence_required: Praise and encouragement events, how mistakes are handled, warm or dismissive remarks, with quotes.
feedback_themes: need a better happy interaction with the kids

dimensions.name: Lesson structure, closing and homework
dimensions.description: Clear progression through the lesson, a recap or conclusion at the end, and homework or practice assigned.
dimensions.evidence_required: Activity and explanation sequence; recap/conclusion and homework events, especially in the last ~10 minutes.

dimensions.name: Professional setup (camera, 8x8 background, lighting)
dimensions.description: Tutor's camera is on with face visible, the 8x8 branded background (white '88' logo) is used, and the tutor is adequately lit.
dimensions.evidence_required: Visual observations from sampled frames. Requires the visual stage; score null without it.
feedback_themes: sit in a space with light

not_observable: Prior warnings or history with the tutor (e.g. 'informed about the quality issues several times').
Anything outside the recording: preparation, punctuality to the scheduled time, parent feedback.
